newsitem.title: JAPAN: Asahi Breweries sees weaker ties with Foster's.
newsitem.headline: Asahi Breweries sees weaker ties with Foster's.

text.p: Asahi Breweries Ltd said on Thursday its relationship with Foster's Brewing Group Ltd of Australia was likely to weaken after Foster's repurchase of its own shares from Asahi.
"We think that the relationship will weaken," an Asahi spokesman said.
He said Asahi's asset management unit in Australia would sell most of the stake it currently held in Foster's.
Currently the Asahi unit has a stake of 270 million shares, or 13.8 percent, of Foster's of which it will sell 254 million shares at Foster's request, the Asahi spokesman said.
Asahi has not yet calculated the profit it will gain from the share sale, the spokesman said.
